name: YMCA Camp Pawtucket
description_short: A YMCA summer day camp for ages 5–13 at the Pawtucket Family YMCA in downtown Pawtucket. Campers rotate through daily activities including crafts, swimming, group games and time outdoors.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is listed among daily activities; the camp is based at the Pawtucket Family YMCA. Pool details and swim testing are not described.
